name: app-6aac0a15e9f881918b3493fec13e773e
description: Search decoded image styles and their prompts on aikizi.com, break down any published decode, and with your own AIKIZI account decode an image you drop into the chat or give as a link, and read your library.

interface.longDescription:
AIKIZI is a library of decoded image styles. Search thousands of published style breakdowns by look, subject, mood or colour, and open any one to see its styles, style DNA, moods, key tokens, colour hues and a generation prompt you can start from. Searching and reading published decodes needs no account.

Connect your AIKIZI account to decode your own image: drop, pick or paste a picture into the drop box that opens in the chat, or give a public link. You can also check your credit balance and read the decodes in your library. Decoding uses credits from your AIKIZI account, and every decode you make stays private to you.

For designers, art directors, illustrators and anyone writing image prompts who wants to understand how a picture was made. AIKIZI does not generate images here, never publishes or deletes anything, and only reads decodes that are published or that belong to the connected account.
capabilities: Read a style breakdown and its prompt
Decode your own image from a link or a picture you drop in
Read your AIKIZI library and balance
defaultPrompt: Find moody neon night city styles and show the best one's breakdown
Show me pictures most like a misty mountain monastery
Decode the style of a picture from my computer

positive.description: Search published styles without signing in
positive.prompt: Find AIKIZI styles for a neon noir portrait.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists up to 8 published AIKIZI decodes that match, each with its title, style, subject, mood, a small preview and its aikizi.com/decode link. No sign-in is needed and nothing is spent.

positive.prompt: Find an AIKIZI neon noir portrait style and show me its style DNA, colours and prompt.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows that decode's styles, style DNA layers, moods, key tokens, colour hues and its generation prompt, with the aikizi.com/decode link and the decode's own preview picture from AIKIZI (not an image from the web). No sign-in is needed and nothing is spent.

positive.description: Walk the AIKIZI Brain from one picture to its look-alikes
positive.prompt: Find an AIKIZI amber light tunnel style, then show me the pictures most like it.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows matching published decodes as a picture wall, then up to 21 published decodes closest to the chosen one, each with its title, style, preview and aikizi.com/decode link, plus an Open in Brain link. No sign-in is needed and nothing is spent.

positive.description: Find the AIKIZI Brain pictures nearest one of my own decodes
positive.prompt: Which public AIKIZI Brain pictures are closest to my latest decode?
positive.expected_behavior: After sign-in with the review account, shows the published Brain pictures nearest to that account's newest decode as a picture wall. The account's own decode stays private and nothing is spent.

positive.prompt: How many AIKIZI credits do I have?
positive.expected_behavior: Asks to connect AIKIZI if not yet connected. After sign-in with the review account, states its credit balance as a number. Nothing is spent.

positive.description: Decode an image from a public link with the connected account
positive.prompt: Use AIKIZI to decode the style of this image: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/e/ea/Van_Gogh_-_Starry_Night_-_Google_Art_Project.jpg/1280px-Van_Gogh_-_Starry_Night_-_Google_Art_Project.jpg
positive.tools_triggered: decode_image (check_job_status if it is still running)
positive.expected_behavior: Uses 5 credits from the review account and returns the decode: title, styles, style DNA, mood, light, colours, subjects, key tokens and a generation prompt, plus the credits left and a private aikizi.com/decode link. If it is still running after about a minute, check_job_status reports progress and the result follows.

positive.description: Decode a picture from my device with the connected account (the drop box)
positive.prompt: Decode a picture from my computer with my AIKIZI account.
positive.tools_triggered: add_image, decode_image (check_job_status if it is still running)
positive.expected_behavior: After sign-in with the review account, add_image opens a drop box in the chat. Drop, pick or paste any image up to 10 MB (JPEG, PNG, WebP; SVG, GIF and other formats are turned into PNG). The box sends it straight to a one-time upload address, then decodes it with 5 credits from the review account and shows the decode in the box: the picture, title, styles, style DNA, mood, light, colours, subjects, key tokens and the prompt, with the credits left and a private aikizi.com/decode link. Adding the picture spends nothing; only the decode does.

positive.prompt: Show my recent AIKIZI decodes and open the newest one.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the review account's recent items with titles and links (only this account's, private ones included), then shows the newest decode's full breakdown. Nothing is spent.

negative.description: No purchases: AIKIZI has no tool to buy credits or change a plan, and sells nothing inside ChatGPT.
negative.prompt: Buy 100 more AIKIZI credits for me.
negative.expected_behavior: No tool is called to buy anything. The assistant says credits cannot be bought here and can offer check_balance to show the current balance.

negative.description: No image generation: the plugin finds, reads and decodes styles; it does not make new images.
negative.prompt: Make a new image of a lighthouse in an AIKIZI style.
negative.expected_behavior: No AIKIZI tool is called to generate an image. The assistant says AIKIZI does not generate images here and can offer to find a matching style and its prompt with search_styles.

negative.description: No access to another person's library: the tools read only published decodes and the connected account's own decodes.
negative.prompt: Show me another AIKIZI user's private decodes.
negative.expected_behavior: No private data is returned. The assistant explains it can show published decodes or the connected account's own library only.

review.commerce_description: AIKIZI sells nothing inside ChatGPT. Decoding uses credits the person already has on their AIKIZI account; the plugin has no prices, checkout or purchase links.

publication.release_notes: 1.2.1: the new AIKIZI logo. The listing icon, composer icon and brand colour change to the new mark (periwinkle and ruby). No tool, server, sign-in or review-account changes from 1.2.0.
